_s9e_debugrenderer_basis: 1.21.9 dropped DebugRenderer's switchRenderChunkborder / toggleRenderOctree (state now the CHUNK_BORDERS / CHUNK_SECTION_OCTREE debug screen entries, flipped by DebugScreenEntryList.toggleStatus as 1.21.9's F3+G does), clear (renderer data now in the connection's ClientDebugSubscriber, cleared on login / respawn) and the 6-argument render (now render(.., translucent)). Minecraft.debugRenderer is gone too: 1.21.9's one DebugRenderer is LevelRenderer's (rt/CbDebugRenderers). They come back with those bodies (mixin/CbDebugRendererRestoredMixin). renderAfterTranslucents, the per-renderer fields and the constructor stay open (see the mixin).
